blocks.content: Igneous rocks are called primary rocks because all other rock types are directly or indirectly derived from them.

rows: Cooling and solidification of magma or lava
Weathering, deposition, and lithification of sediments
Recrystallization due to high pressure and temperature

items: Fossils are found only in sedimentary rocks; igneous rocks never contain fossils, while metamorphism destroys them.
Deccan Traps are composed of extrusive igneous basaltic rock, which weathers to form black cotton soil (Regur).
Common metamorphic pairs frequently asked in exams: Limestone transforms to Marble, Sandstone to Quartzite, Shale to Slate, and Granite to Gneiss.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Igneous rocks are formed by the cooling and crystallization of molten magma or lava and serve as the primary source for all other rock types.
Sedimentary rocks develop through weathering, erosion, deposition, compaction, and lithification of existing rock fragments or organic matter.
Metamorphic rocks arise from the alteration of pre-existing rocks under extreme thermal and pressure conditions without complete melting.
Fossils are exclusively preserved in sedimentary rocks, as the heat and pressure associated with igneous and metamorphic processes destroy organic remains.
